subject: Rivermark: Request for heavy year-1 prepay + term discount — approval needed
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@rivermark.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: carlos.mendez@rivermark.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal — question on year-1 prepay and discount

Vanessa, thanks for the proposal yesterday. A couple quick points from our side as we prep legal and finance:

- We can do a 3-year commitment but need most of the prepaid dollars in year 1 due to our budget calendar (target: 70% Y1, 20% Y2, 10% Y3).
- We are asking for a 35% term discount off list for the committed volume; we believe the usage profile justifies it given the heavy frontload.
- We need clarity on refund/cancellation protections and SLAs for dedicated capacity.

Can you get internal signoff on the discount + ramp? If there’s flexibility on how discounts apply to overage/tiering, that would also help.

—Sarah
CFO, Rivermark Financial

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@rivermark.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 15:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal — question on year-1 prepay and discount

Sarah — thanks for the clarity, I’ll loop in finance and the deal desk for an internal review. Quick notes so you know what we’ll ask approval for: 3-year reserved commitment, 70/20/10 frontloaded draw schedule, 35% term discount applied to committed units, standard SLA with a dedicated capacity addendum, and a pro-rated refund window for the first 60 days if we materially miss SLA.

I’ve attached the proposed term sheet for internal review. Will follow up with next steps by tomorrow EOB.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Rivermark prepay request — need pricing approval

Team — forwarding Rivermark’s ask (see below). Key asks: 70% year-1 prepay, 3-yr commitment, and a 35% term discount on committed units. They’re a strategic fintech account (RM is in the pipeline for Q3). Attachments: proposed_term_sheet_RM-2026-042.xlsx and RFP response.

Why I’m escalating: 35% is outside standard playbook for a 3-year prepay at this size and the heavy year-1 draw increases cash/revenue recognition exposure. They are asking for a simple application of discount to overages as well.

What I’m proposing for approval:
- Approve a maximum 30% term discount on committed units, with 25% guaranteed and a 5% performance-based rebate tied to SLA/usage thresholds.
- Allow the 70/20/10 frontload schedule but move refund window to 30 days for dedicated capacity to limit exposure.
- Overage pricing: apply list price above committed units; offer 10% off list for overages up to 120% of committed usage.

Please advise if we can sign off or if finance/leadership needs to review.

Thanks,
Vanessa

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 19:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Rivermark prepay request — need pricing approval

Vanessa — I like the creative split (25% base + 5% SLA rebate) to protect revenue while giving the customer upside. A couple of finance notes from my side:
- 30% max term discount is likely acceptable but only with the performance/rebate structure and a stricter refund clause (we should push to 30-day pro-rated).
- For heavy year-1 cash, we need commitments documented for order to revenue mapping; I’ll ask revenue ops to confirm how this interacts with ASC 606 guidance for prepaid multi-year deals.
- We should require a 90-day usage review after launch to revisit tiering/overage thresholds.

If finance is good, I can take this to Vivek for final signoff today.

-Rishi
Head of Sales Operations

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Rivermark prepay request — need pricing approval

Thanks for the summary. I’m comfortable approving the deal with the following conditions:
1) 30% term discount cap (structure: 25% guaranteed + 5% SLA/rebate)
2) 70/20/10 prepay profile is OK but escrow language required for year-1 funds and a 30-day pro-rated refund window for the dedicated capacity addendum.
3) Overage pricing: list price with a max 10% off up to 120% usage; beyond that standard list.
4) Require a kickoff & 90-day usage review; pricing subject to adjustment after review.

Vanessa, please send the updated term sheet back to Rivermark with these changes and mark the deal as approved by leadership (Vivek). Copy Revenue Ops on the DocuSign.

-Vivek
VP, Revenue

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@rivermark.com>, carlos.mendez@rivermark.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 10:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Updated term sheet — RM-2026-042 (approved)

Sarah — thanks for the patience. Leadership has approved the 3-year prepay with a heavy year-1 draw under the conditions below (see attached updated term sheet):

- Discount: 25% applied to committed units, plus a 5% SLA/rebate that pays out after a 12-month SLA/usage review (total potential 30%).
- Ramp: 70% Y1 / 20% Y2 / 10% Y3 prepaid draw. Year-1 funds will be held in escrow and applied per the attached dedicated capacity addendum.
- Refunds: 30-day pro-rated refund window from go-live for dedicated capacity only; standard hosted API commitments non-refundable after kickoff.
- Overage: list price with up to 10% off for usage <= 120% of committed units, otherwise list pricing.
- Governance: mandatory 90-day usage review to revisit tiering and adjust future year allocations; DocuSign to include a clause for adjustment after the review.

Attachments: proposed_term_sheet_RM-2026-042.xlsx (updated), Rivermark_RFP_Response.pdf

If this works, can you confirm acceptance and I’ll route the DocuSign to your legal and our RevOps team for signatures.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
